localChanges: When Settlers clear Forest, Jungle or Swamp, or plant Forest, the square's special now follows it as in Civilization: a square without one stays without, and a square with one keeps exactly one. Before, a new special could appear from nowhere, or the same one twice (closes #1038).
Grassland made from Jungle or Swamp now gets a Shield half the time, not three times in four.
A city working a square whose terrain changes now gets the new terrain's yield straight away, rather than the old terrain's.

log: The new terrain a conversion builds rolls its own features when it is made, before the square takes it, and the TerrainChanged rules only took the old terrain's features away. So a square could gain a special it never had, or the same special twice, and Grassland cleared from Jungle or Swamp got a Shield about 75% of the time. Each conversion rule now takes off whatever the new terrain rolled before giving it the square's special, and the Jungle/Swamp rule rolls the Grassland's Shield itself, once.
A new rule clears the square's cached yields after any terrain change, which nothing did before.
